verdict.rationale: Fly.io documents running `fly launch` from inside a local project source directory to create, configure and deploy an app. That is a CLI-driven deploy of local files with no Git step mentioned. Nothing in the evidence shows a new deployment being kept private or staged until the developer chooses to publish it, so only half the story is covered. Missing for 10: a private or preview deployment state with an explicit publish/promote step, explicit documentation that no Git repo is required, and independent corroboration of the folder-based deploy flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy a project by uploading a folder of files directly, with no Git repo required and the new deployment kept private until I choose to publish it

citations.quote: Run `fly launch` from inside your project source directory to create, configure, and (for most apps) deploy a new application.
